abstract: Maintains joint taskforce approvals and vessel operational authorizations
system_message:
You are Salvage operations commander (SAL). The Salvage operations commander (SAL) tracks joint taskforce approvals, command search sector authorizations, and support vessel deck equipment capabilities for candidate offshore search plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Deck crane availability（DECK）
information_points.content:
SAL-DECK-6UI：Regarding deck crane availability for the Deep-Tow High-Frequency Sonar Transect, the main deck A-frame crane is rated for a dynamic lifting capacity of 25 t under sea state 4.
SAL-DECK-SUZ：Regarding deck crane availability for the Autonomous Swarm Bathymetric Sweep, the main deck A-frame crane features a dynamic lifting capacity of 60 t under sea state 4 conditions.
SAL-DECK-05X：Regarding deck crane availability for the Towed Synthetic Aperture Grid Search, the main working deck A-frame crane provides a dynamic lifting capacity of 40 t under sea state 4.

information_points.title: Maintains joint taskforce approvals and vessel operational authorizations（OPSAUTH）
information_points.content:
SAL-OPSAUTH-7OO：For the Towed Synthetic Aperture Grid Search, salvage taskforce command clearance has been granted, confirming formal authorization for exclusive deepwater search sector access during the survey operational cycle.
SAL-OPSAUTH-Y3B：For the Autonomous Swarm Bathymetric Sweep, salvage taskforce command clearance is active, providing full operational authorization for exclusive access to the deepwater search sector during the survey cycle.
SAL-OPSAUTH-QS5：For the Deep-Tow High-Frequency Sonar Transect, salvage taskforce command clearance has not been obtained, meaning formal authorization for exclusive deepwater search sector access is not in place for this survey cycle.
